messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down. (since 2025-02-11; source standup/boreal/2025-02-11)
- The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. (since 2025-04-07; source standup/ember/2025-04-07)
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. (since 2025-02-05; source incident-review/INC-2025-004)
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. (since 2025-02-05; source incident-review/INC-2025-004)
- [decision] The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21)
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. (since 2025-06-27; source handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction)
  - earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. (held 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; source handover/2025-06-11-notifier)
  - earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. (held 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; source standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2)
- Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. (since 2025-03-26; source standup/dune/2025-03-26)
- The Boreal team observed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. (since 2025-11-03; source standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2)
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. (since 2025-03-04; source standup/atlas/2025-03-04)
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. (since 2025-01-09; source standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2)
- The reporting service is owned by the Ember team. (since 2026-04-13; source standup/ember/2026-04-13-2)
  - earlier: The reporting service is owned by team Dune. (held 2025-01-20 to 2026-04-13; source standup/dune/2025-01-20-2)
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- [constraint] The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. (since 2025-03-26; source standup/dune/2025-03-26)
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
  - earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. (held 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-01-21)
- [decision] The webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, a follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review. (since 2026-02-26; source incident-review/INC-2026-003)
- Team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the reporting service's owners. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-2)
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. (since 2026-04-13; source standup/ember/2026-04-13-2)
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- The job scheduler is not the Boreal team's service, so the Boreal team flagged it. (since 2025-12-01; source standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2)
- [decision] As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. (since 2025-05-15; source handover/2025-05-15-webhooks)
  - earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team. (held 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; source handover/2025-03-03-webhooks)
  - earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. (held 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; source standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3)

Question: Which service does the notifier depend on?

message.reasoning: The memory says: "The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down." So the notifier depends on the bus.
